result.summary: The application interface displays one clear layout issue regarding overlapping elements.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' card for the second restaurant (pizza) overlaps with the navigation menu at the bottom, making its lower portion difficult to interact with or view.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the bottom padding or margin of the main scrollable container to ensure that all cards, even those at the end of the list, are fully contained within the viewport above the navigation bar.
